verdict.rationale: Docs show a programmatic SDK where code (an agent) can call getSandbox() to provision, exec()/writeFile/readFile to run code and retrieve results, and sandboxes can be left idle or explicitly torn down — all via API calls with no human in the loop, explicitly positioned for 'AI agents that need to execute code.' Community caveats exist around cost, no auto-destroy on idle, and startup latency, but these are operational caveats rather than evidence the end-to-end agent workflow doesn't work.
